title: Design System: Great Day Release World

display.purpose: The release title, filled with the rendered gold bar.

headline.purpose: Section names, the hashtag and the footer line.

title.purpose: Artist and edition names on velvet.

lede.purpose: One supporting sentence beside a section name.

label.purpose: Labels for controls and objects, roles, the theme bar.

shadows.name: rendered-drop

components.name: Play Button
components.description: Velvet disc in a gold ring; the primary action of the world.
components.html: <button class="ds-play" aria-label="Play the preview"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M7 4v16l13-8z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-play { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 78px; height: 78px; border: 5px solid transparent; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #2a4dc0, #0f163e 78%) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, #f4dc94, #e3b75a 55%, #8a5d18 80%, #e9c06a) border-box; color: #f6d988; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 22px 44px rgb(5 8 30 / 0.55), 0 4px 10px rgb(5 8 30 / 0.4); transition: transform 120ms ease-out, filter 200ms ease-out; } .ds-play svg { margin-left: 4px; } .ds-play:hover { filter: brightness(1.14); } .ds-play:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0cd72; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Brushed gold bar with engraved text. In the build the fill is the rendered gold-plate.webp texture.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4dc94, #edc76e 45%, #c99634 72%, #7d5618 82%, #e3b75a); color: #392609; font: 700 0.9rem/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 1px rgb(255 250 225 / 0.8), inset 0 -3px 5px rgb(92 58 10 / 0.55), 0 8px 16px rgb(5 8 30 / 0.45); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0cd72; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Waiting Button
components.description: Disabled state, always labelled with what it waits for.
components.css: .ds-btn-wait { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #080c26; color: #c1cbeb; font: 700 0.9rem/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgb(240 205 114 / 0.45); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Counter Night field with an engraved label above it.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-f">Try the engraver</label><input id="ds-f" class="ds-field" placeholder="What made today great?">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; font: 400 0.7rem Michroma, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f0cd72; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1.5px solid rgb(42 77 192 / 0.75); border-radius: 10px; background: #080c26; color: #f3f5fc; font: 500 1rem/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: rgb(193 203 235 / 0.78); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #f0cd72; outline: none; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0cd72; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Placeholder Tag
components.description: Cotton string tag, only where content is a placeholder.
components.html: $2.99 proposed
components.css: .ds-tag { position: relative; display: inline-flex; margin-left: 34px; rotate: -2deg; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 4px rgb(5 8 30 / 0.45)); } .ds-tag-string { position: absolute; right: calc(100% - 13px); top: 50%; width: 40px; height: 16px; translate: 0 -40%; overflow: visible; } .ds-tag-string path { fill: none; stroke: #ebe4d2; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-tag-paper { position: relative; padding: 0.42rem 0.8rem 0.42rem 1.45rem; background: #f7f4ed; color: #0b185b; font: 700 0.6875rem/1.3 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 10px 100%, 0 50%); } .ds-tag-paper::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 9px; top: 50%; width: 5px; height: 5px; translate: 0 -50%; border-radius: 50%; background: #0f163e; }

components.name: Theme Bar
components.description: An engraved gold ID bar carrying the theme line.
components.html: A Great Day Is a State of Mind
components.css: .ds-bar { display: inline-block; margin: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4dc94, #edc76e 45%, #c99634 72%, #7d5618 82%, #e3b75a); color: #392609; font: 400 0.8rem Michroma, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 244 200 / 0.7); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 1px rgb(255 250 225 / 0.8), inset 0 -3px 5px rgb(92 58 10 / 0.55), 0 10px 22px rgb(5 8 30 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: The release is shown the way a Houston jeweler shows a custom piece: lit from above, under a glass lip, laid on royal-blue case velvet. Every object on the page is something you could find on that counter. The metal is rendered, not drawn: frames, bail, rope chain and brushed bars come from a three.js light tent, and CSS only places, clips and shades them.
keyCharacteristics: Committed color: royal-blue velvet owns most of every viewport; gold carries the light.
Real rendered metal: rope edges, channel-set brilliants, polished round wire.
Gold script nameplates for display type, engraved wide caps for labels, Archivo for reading.
Cotton string tags appear only on placeholders. Their presence means "not final".
One authored motion moment (the case light sweep and nameplate glint) plus physical motion on the hanging pendant.

rules.name: The Velvet Owns the Room Rule
rules.body: Velvet covers most of every viewport. Gold is the light on it, never a field of its own; the largest gold surfaces are plates and frames.

rules.name: The Tinted Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on velvet is Frost Blue. Gray text does not exist in this world.

rules.name: The Nameplate Rule
rules.body: Script is for names: the title, section names and the hashtag. Never set a sentence, a button or a label in it.

rules.name: The Engraved Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Michroma is a label for the control or object directly beneath or around it. It never sits above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Rendered Metal Rule
rules.body: New metal objects are rendered in the light tent (scripts/greatday-render/) and placed as images or textures. Linear gradients do not stand in for gold.

rules.name: The Light From Above Rule
rules.body: Every shadow falls downward. Highlights sit on top edges. The glass lip lives at the top of the hero.

dos: Do render new metal in the light tent and place it as an image or texture.
Do keep velvet as the field and gold as the light.
Do tag every placeholder with a cotton string tag, and only placeholders.
Do keep one authored motion moment per surface: the case light sweep (1.9s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) with the nameplate glint (1.7s). Remove both under reduced motion.
Do give hanging objects physical motion (springs) and keep everything else still.
donts: Don't fill gold with CSS linear gradients or fake metal with stacked bevels.
Don't set sentences, buttons or labels in the script face.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a section name.
Don't add bounce or elastic easing, or hover sway with no state behind it.
Don't use gray secondary text on velvet.
